# Motivation
Remove the following files from the repository because new ASVS users might think these files are the current version of the standard and download them.

OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 3.1.docx
OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 3.1.json
OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 3.1.pdf
OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 3.1.xlsx

The README.md links to the current version at https://www.owasp.org.
title: Remove 3.1 export files from the repository.
